dedupe_keys.name: international waste shipments exported from england environment agency refuse derived fuel and solid recovered fuel

description: This dataset records international waste shipments notified under the Transfrontier Shipment of Waste Regulations 2007 by producers and receivers registered in England, published by the Environment Agency. Shipments are attributed to the country where the producer or receiver is registered, whatever port they pass through. The dataset starts with refuse-derived fuel and solid recovered fuel, combustible waste from mechanical treatment of municipal and commercial waste, with other waste types to be added. Shipments are recorded in four groups covering waste leaving the United Kingdom and waste arriving in the receiving country, with quantities by notifier and destination. Files are free to download from the Defra data services platform as Excel workbooks for 2025 and 2026 and a zipped archive for 2017 to 2024; the licence is not stated in the catalogue metadata read. Caveats: coverage is limited to notified shipments of the listed waste types, and records reflect notifications, not verified tonnages. Simulation uses: modelling cross-border flows of waste-derived fuel between England and European energy-from-waste plants, testing how port or trade disruption shifts waste to domestic landfill and treatment, and calibrating waste logistics network models. Related records: the Basel Convention national reporting (data-basel-convention-national-reporting) covers transboundary waste movements globally.
